result.title: HTCE: Homeomorphism-inspired Topological Cross-Scene Experience Canonicalization and Reuse for Object Navigation
result.summary: As embodied agents perform object-goal navigation across residential environments, they accumulate successful experiences whose semantic structure recurs across scenes even when geometric trajectories do not. Reusing such experience is challenging because differences in region naming and observation granularity produce distinct graph representations of similar approaches, while meaningful differences in anchors, branches, and endpoints must stay distinguishable. We introduce HTCE, a homeomorphism-inspired topological framework that canonicalizes and reuses navigation experience. Feature and topology subdivisions characterize representational variations, and their semantically constrained reductions produce comparable semantic sequences and structural signatures while preserving semantic anchors, branching relations, and navigation endpoints. HTCE then retrieves historical successful approaches through subdivision-aware matching as guidance for a frozen vision-language policy. Canonicalization compresses the experience index losslessly, merging 17.7--23.6\% of distinct stored route descriptions while retaining full task performance. Under a single frozen vision-language backbone shared by all compared systems, HTCE attains the best SR and SPL in every setting---59.9\%/31.8\% on HM3D v0.1, 71.0\%/31.5\% on HM3D v0.2, and 46.6\%/16.6\% on MP3D---with SR gains of up to 4.9 points and structured retrieval contributing up to 2.8 SPL points. The code is available in https://github.com/startracker0/htce.git

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 HTCE，一个受同胚思想启发的拓扑框架，把跨场景的目标导航成功经验规范化：在保留语义锚点、分支关系与导航终点的前提下对齐区域命名和观察粒度差异，再以子划分感知的匹配检索历史路线，引导冻结的视觉语言策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「压缩表面差异、保留任务必要结构」的经验图规范化和检索引导思路，可能为 latent 状态的可比性、视觉证据筛选与跨场景复用提供概念参照，但属具身导航的检索式引导，与 LVR 的推理期 latent 生成机制联系较远，需核查。
